channel_routing_policy.content: Routing policy v3.1. Rule 1: If prospect submitted a demo request or replied requesting follow-up, route to EMAIL with a personalized reply. Rule 2: If prospect is highly active on LinkedIn (>5,000 connections AND recent activity in last 30 days) and email deliverability is uncertain, route to LINKEDIN invite. Rule 3: If prospect stated an email preference, always EMAIL. Rule 4: Default to EMAIL when deliverable; fall back to LINKEDIN only if email is non-deliverable. Rule 5: Never contact the same prospect on two channels in one campaign wave.

campaign_messaging_templates.content: Approved Q1 templates. EMAIL_INTRO: 'Hi {first_name}, I lead partnerships at our team and noticed {signal}. We help {company_type} cut operational overhead by 18% on average. Open to a 15-minute intro?' LINKEDIN_INVITE: 'Hi {first_name} — connecting after seeing your work at {company}. Would love to share how we help teams like yours.' All templates require a named signal reference per prospect.

tools.name: get_campaign_target_rows
tools.description: Read the prospect rows from the Q1_Targets worksheet of the campaign targets spreadsheet, including prospect name, company, title, email, LinkedIn URL, and current status.

tools.name: lookup_prospect_profile
tools.description: Retrieve enrichment details for each prospect (LinkedIn connection count, activity recency, account type, email deliverability) to inform channel selection.

tools.name: get_prospect_engagement_signal
tools.description: Retrieve the most recent engagement signal per prospect (whitepaper downloads, demo requests, replies, profile views) to personalize messaging and prioritize warm leads.

tools.name: classify_outreach_channel
tools.description: Apply the routing policy to each prospect's profile and engagement signal to determine the recommended outreach channel (email or LinkedIn) and the rationale.

tools.name: draft_outreach_plan
tools.description: Compose a draft outreach plan listing, per prospect, the recommended channel, the suggested personalized message, and the routing rationale, plus a channel breakdown summary, for the user to review and adjust before anything is sent.

tools.name: send_prospect_email
tools.description: Send an outreach email to a prospect's email address.

tools.name: send_linkedin_connection_invite
tools.description: Send a LinkedIn connection invitation with a message to a prospect's LinkedIn profile.

tools.name: update_campaign_row_status
tools.description: Write the channel used, outreach date, and updated status back into a prospect's row in the campaign targets spreadsheet.

tools.name: post_campaign_summary_to_slack
tools.description: Post a campaign summary with the per-channel breakdown and affected prospect names to the #campaign-ops Slack channel.

tools.name: read_messaging_templates
tools.description: Read the approved Q1 messaging templates for email and LinkedIn outreach to use as the basis for drafted messages.

tools.name: list_slack_channels
tools.description: List available Slack channels and their posting conventions for reference.

tools.name: lookup_sales_team_directory
tools.description: Look up sales team members, vertical ownership, and approval routing for the campaign.
